ValidationRule.description: The ‘Quantity Notification %’ must be completed with the ‘User Notification’ field & vica versa.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND( NOT( ISBLANK( User_Notification__c ) ) , ISBLANK( Quantity_Notification__c ) ) , AND( NOT( ISBLANK( Quantity_Notification__c ) ) , ISBLANK( User_Notification__c ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Quantity Notification % User Notification fields both need to be completed to save.
